description: UK customer statement of account (Sample Wholesale Supplies Ltd, fictional) listing invoices, credit notes and payments for August-October 2026, produced with fpdf2 2.9.0 using non-embedded core fonts (Courier for the transaction rows, Helvetica for headings, cp1252). Amounts use the ledger convention 1,234.56 DR / 150.00 CR, dates dd/mm/yyyy, 'Page X of Y' footers, a header row repeated on each page, an aged-balance grid, a credit-use bar drawn with rectangles and a remittance slip with a dashed cut line and an Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode. Edits: a missing invoice INV 40871 inserted on page 1, the due date of INV 40626 extended, a payment that had been posted as DR corrected to CR, the reason text of credit note CRN 7344 changed; the aged balance and the credit-use bar are recomputed. Consequences not listed: the last row of page 1 (PAY 88123) moves to page 2, the whole summary block (aged balance, credit bar, remittance slip with barcode) no longer fits on page 2 and moves to a new page 3, and the footers change from 'Page n of 2' to 'Page n of 3'. The 2 months and Older buckets are unchanged.

truth.note: Whole new row dated 12/09/2026, due 12/10/2026, 1,820.40 DR.
Due date of INV 40626 (30/08/2026, Delivery 7626 - Sandpaper rolls) extended; the description is in the snippet because another invoice is also due 15/10/2026.

Payment PAY 88213 (20/10/2026) corrected from debit to credit: a sign change written with the DR/CR suffix, which the README does not list among recognised sign notations. A report as a word change DR -> CR is equally correct.
Details of credit note CRN 7344 (23/10/2026); the August credit notes keep 'damaged'. Snippet unique on that page.
Aged balance, Current (October) bucket: -300.00 from the sign correction.
Aged balance, 1 month (September) bucket: +1,820.40 from the inserted invoice.
Credit-use bar: filled part grows from 69% to 84% of the bar; rect is the whole bar outline. The bar is on a different page after the edit (summary block moved).
